title: Complaints about Missing Mail and Postal Quality of Service
what_it_is: Complaints about Missing Mail and Postal Quality of Service

sections.label: IMDA fines SingPost
sections.summary: IMDA imposed a $100,000 financial penalty on SingPost last week for failing to meet 2017 QoS standards.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: IMDA imposed a financial penalty of $100,000 on SingPost last week for failing to meet the QoS standards in 2017.

sections.label: SingPost misdelivered mail complaints
sections.summary: In 2018, SingPost received 91 complaints about misdelivered and lost mail.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: In 2018, SingPost received 91 complaints about misdelivered and lost mail.

sections.label: Complaints submitted to IMDA
sections.summary: Eight such complaints were submitted directly to IMDA in 2018, and seven in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Eight such complaints were submitted directly to IMDA in 2018, and seven in 2017.

sections.label: IMDA considering parcel standards
sections.summary: IMDA is considering regulatory standards for the delivery of parcels and registered articles.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: IMDA will pay attention to this area as well.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: It is now considering regulatory standards for the delivery of parcels and registered articles.

sections.label: SingPost operating profit noted
sections.summary: SingPost made a profit of $42.2 million on operating activities.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Because I noted that SingPost made a profit of $42.2 million on operating activities.

sections.label: Question on fine amount
sections.summary: The question asks why SingPost was only fined $100,000 given lapses and possible fines of up to $50,000 a month per indicator.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The third question is: they are found, according to the report last week, to have many lapses in 2017, and falling short can result in a fine of up to $50,000 a month for each indicator.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: My question is: why were they only fined $100,000.

sections.label: Action to restore public trust
sections.summary: The passage asks what action will be taken generally and at Yishun Town to bring back people's trust and confidence.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Last but not least, and this is the most important question: what action will be taken in general, and at Yishun Town in particular, in order to bring back the trust and confidence of the people?

sections.label: Yishun complaints and postmen redeployment
sections.summary: IMDA noted some complaints pertained to Yishun, discussed with SingPost, and SingPost redeployed two experienced postmen to Yishun beats as of November 2018.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Indeed, amongst the complaints that SingPost received and the ones that have been sent to IMDA last year, IMDA has noted that some of these complaints pertain to the Yishun area.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: It has discussed with SingPost and SingPost has redeployed two experienced postmen to cover the Yishun beats as of November 2018.

sections.label: IMDA discretion on financial penalty
sections.summary: Under the QoS framework, IMDA has discretion to decide how much financial penalty to levy for each count of failing the QoS.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: First, allow me to explain that under the QoS framework, IMDA does have discretion to decide how much financial penalty to levy for each count of failing the QoS.

sections.label: More expected from IMDA
sections.summary: More can be expected from IMDA in the coming months.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: More can be expected from IMDA in the coming months.

sections.label: SingPost profit from postal service
sections.summary: In the last financial year, 90% of SingPost's profit came from postal service, despite emails' popularity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
sentences.text: With the increased popularity of emails, we often think that snail mail will lose its popularity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
sentences.text: But when we look at the annual financial report of SingPost, in the last financial year, 90% of SingPost's profit comes from postal service.

sections.label: Locker trials in Bukit Panjang and Punggol
sections.summary: Locker trials have started in two locations in Bukit Panjang and in Punggol under the Locker Alliance.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: In terms of other solutions that the Member had asked, I would also like to take this opportunity to say that locker trials have started in two locations in Bukit Panjang and in Punggol under the Locker Alliance.

sections.label: SingPost delivery decision and postmen shortage
sections.summary: IMDA aims to decide on SingPost's 2018 letter delivery by mid-year, and Yishun has 30-plus postmen instead of 40-over.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: We make no assumptions as to how long this journey is going to take.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: But I can share at this moment that IMDA aims to release its decision with regard to SingPost's 2018 letter delivery by the middle of this year.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: During my recent visit to SingPost's Woodlands distribution centre, I came to understand that, actually, there is a shortage of postmen serving in Yishun Town.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: There are supposed to be 40-over postmen, but they only have 30-plus.

sections.label: SingPost competition and licence lapses
sections.summary: SingPost faces competition, and the QoS lapses do not warrant removing its licence.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: But as I have mentioned, SingPost is not immune to competition here.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: I do not think at this moment that the lapses in terms of the QoS standards are such that it warrants removing of the licence.
